changelog:
Initial release of prd-for-agents skill:

- Generates industry-standard, agent-optimized Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) tailored for AI coding and developer agents.
- Enforces comprehensive output structure, including quantitative success metrics, user stories, dependencies, risks, a sequenced agent build order, and more.
- Provides detailed checklists, best practices, and routing rules to ensure all PRDs are complete, testable, and ready for agent handoff.
- Designed to fill common gaps in traditional and agent-generated PRDs, improving project clarity and execution.
